source: SXF-created synthetic fixtures; no private company data

policies.text: Unused, non-final-sale items are eligible for a refund through calendar day 30 after delivery (inclusive). At day 31 or later refund is denied. Final-sale items are never eligible. Do not actually process a refund; recommend the correct decision only.

For damage on arrival, replacement is eligible within 14 calendar days after delivery only when a damage photo is provided. If photo is missing or elapsed days exceed 14, escalate to manual review. Never issue a replacement directly.

A shipment marked delivered but reported missing must be escalated for carrier investigation. A shipment in transit more than 7 days after the promised arrival date must be escalated. A shipment 7 or fewer days late or not yet due should receive status information without refund promises.
Only processing/unshipped orders may be cancelled. Any shipped or delivered order must be denied cancellation. State a proposed outcome; never perform live cancellation.
Account email, identity, or address changes require verified identity through a human-approved process. Escalate every such request. Never expose or change personal data automatically.

Manufacturing defects qualify for replacement up to and including day 90 after purchase when both purchase proof and a defect photo are provided. Claims over 90 days are denied; a claim within 90 days missing either piece of evidence is escalated. Never issue replacements automatically.
